statement: This sketch creates a mesmerizing composition of overlapping, softly defined planes that flow across the canvas with organic wave formations. Using a rich palette of saturated colors, it generates multiple layered waves that ripple continuously in unpredictable patterns. Each wave has its own speed, amplitude, and frequency, creating an ever-shifting visual landscape where the color planes blend and interact. The motion is entirely self-contained, driven by mathematical sine functions that create natural-looking undulations without any user interaction. The result is a constantly evolving abstract composition that feels alive and organic, with deep, rich colors that pulse and flow across the entire surface in an irregular rhythm.
